autoSummary: Automatically tag your local audio files from online platforms using artist and title tags, filenames or playlists. You can also identify audio with Shazam.
audioSummary: Tag local audio files with Spotify audio features using ISRC tags or exact matches. A free account is required.
quickSummary: Quickly tag files with energy, mood, genre and your own values using keyboard shortcuts. Manual Tag fetches metadata for individual tracks.
renameSummary: Rename files automatically from their tags. A template defines the new filenames and supports functions for batch processing.

autoWorkflowGuide: Select platforms and drag their cards to set fallback priority. Choose a folder or playlist, select the tags to fetch, review platform and advanced options, then start tagging.
audioWorkflowGuide: Connect your Spotify account, choose the audio files and matching method, select audio features and destination tag fields, then review thresholds before starting.
quickWorkflowGuide: Open Settings to choose a folder or playlist. Define energy, moods, genres, custom values and destination tag fields. Assign keyboard shortcuts, listen to each track, apply values and save.
editorWorkflowGuide: Choose a folder using the path control, then select a file to inspect its tags. Edit, add or remove fields and save. Enable Your list in Preferences to collect files from multiple folders.
manualWorkflowGuide: Select a track and open Manual Tag. Choose platforms and tags, start the search, select the matching release and apply it. Open a result’s link to verify the release before writing.
renameWorkflowGuide: Choose the source folder and define a filename template using the documented variables and functions. Review the preview and destination before renaming. Keep template keywords unchanged; use / to separate folders.
